purpose: Replace the highest-information TP1 matrix blanks with measured evidence while preserving the already-qualified MTP0 graph-on F16 cell and every historical speed result.

coverage_axes.short_suite: separate evidence type outside the numeric active_context_tokens axis
coverage_axes.warning: 210 exact decision states are not 210 required real runs. The banked short suite cannot fill active_context_tokens=0. The serving probe's 32000 input plus 128 output is a practical 32K serving target and cannot fill active_context_tokens=32768. Estimates, supporting probes, and parent-closed cells must never be plotted as exact measured active-context points. Auto KV aliases resolved float16 and is not a fourth run.

frozen_identity.architecture_transfer_scope: Optimization mechanisms discovered on Qwen3.6 are transfer candidates for Qwen3.8; model identity, quality, and speed evidence do not transfer without a Qwen3.8 run.
frozen_identity.graph_off: XPU_GRAPH, VLLM_XPU_ENABLE_XPU_GRAPH, force-graph variables, and compilation_config are absent.

delegated_runtime.phase_policy: First phase uses CACHE_POLICY=fresh. An authorized expansion uses CACHE_POLICY=replay plus the exact first-phase cache manifest; no phase mutates or resumes an output directory. The delegated harness stops on its exit-14 canary before benchmark/quality. Parent-specific oracle, acceptance, and retrieval resolution remains fail-closed outside runner final.status.

p3-eager-mtp2.environment: graph_off; PROMPT_IDS=selection--incident-retrospective,selection--technical-guide; MAX_TOKENS=512; BENCH=1; NATURAL_EOS=1; QUALITY=0. Full-short replay is authorized only after acceptance/oracle resolution.

p4-graph-mtp1.environment: graph_on; PROMPT_IDS=selection--incident-retrospective,selection--technical-guide; MAX_TOKENS=512; BENCH=1; NATURAL_EOS=1; QUALITY=0. Full-short replay is authorized only after acceptance/oracle resolution.

p6-e5m2-kv-init.environment: graph_off; MAX_TOKENS=128; BENCH=0; NATURAL_EOS=0; QUALITY=0. A successful init/canary authorizes a fresh full-short phase in a new output/root suffix.

banked_cell.website_use: measured quality-clean dated snapshot evidence, not a replicated record-grade strict pair
banked_cell.quality: 7 exact; 8 repeat with one hash; 8K needle; 24/24 baseline; cache-zero; strict B was not run only because the superseded continuous-freshness policy stopped it

parents.gate: Run 2K then 8K then the 32000-input/128-output serving target on one fresh server. Correctness/retrieval/capacity/runtime failures stop deeper probes; speed never stops expansion. If 8K passes and 32000-input fails, test 16K then 24K and publish the measured serving boundary. These probes support estimation but do not directly fill exact active_context_tokens cells; context 0 and exact 32768 remain missing until an exact-depth harness measures them.
Establish the exact eager MTP/KV short-suite control. Add the 8192- and 32000-input serving probes only if the short run is quality-clean; neither is relabeled as an exact active-context cell.

Any boot, corruption, zero-acceptance, oracle, or canary failure blocks deeper MTP for this snapshot. If clean, run the full short battery. Even if slow, authorize exactly one MTP4 eager short actual; MTP1/MTP3 remain estimates unless the shape would change a site conclusion.
A correctness failure quarantines graph-on MTP1-4 on b2dd only; eager and later snapshots remain open. Graph MTP4 requires both this parent and the eager MTP4 child to be clean.

A measured quality failure is retained as a low-grade/quarantined parent and closes descendants. Intersections run only after both relevant parents pass. The long serving child is not an exact active_context_tokens=32768 cell.
Only a specifically evidenced dtype/init rejection is unsupported. If boot and canary pass, run the same full battery as e4m3; an unrelated harness failure remains failed, never unsupported.

quality_contract.full_benchmark: 25 cold unique prompts, natural EOS, returned token IDs, 100 token events and 99 intervals per row
quality_contract.full_battery: 7 exact canaries, 8-repeat one-hash determinism, 8K needle, 24/24 baseline, and exactly 16 cached_tokens=0 rows inside quality
quality_contract.speculative: Record accepted, draft, and acceptance evidence; zero acceptance is not a speed result and blocks deeper-MTP expansion.
quality_contract.context: Each serving-context row records requested and actual prompt tokens and must return its unique retrieval marker. A serving-input probe is supporting evidence, not an exact active_context_tokens measurement. No interpolation or estimate may appear in a measured active-context graph.

rules: Speed miss is measured evidence and may lower a packet grade, but is never corruption, unsupported, or grounds to overwrite a historical result.
Every estimated, closed-by-parent, quarantined, unsupported, missing, or failed cell carries a parent id, exact reason, and retry condition.
Any missing required file, hash mismatch, ambiguous identity, residual server/container/port/process, quality failure, or incomplete finalization fails closed.
Raw failed attempts are immutable. No parent resumes into its prior root or cache; retries use a new rN suffix and fresh cache.

cleanup_contract: Before and after every arm: exact campaign container absent, selected port free, no matching vLLM/python/model process, no render process, and fresh ext4 cache/root. Cleanup uncertainty fails closed.
publication_rule: The website may combine measured exact cells, explicitly labeled estimates, supporting serving probes, and parent-closed blanks, but may not call estimates or serving probes exact active-context measurements, use the short suite for active_context_tokens=0, use a 32000-input/128-output probe for active_context_tokens=32768, draw measured lines through unmeasured contexts, merge different weight identities, or replace any protected speed evidence. Optimization grade and evidence grade are distinct from raw decode rate.
